a.aria-label: EcoCyc:CPLX0-682 — catalyzes → RHEA:18630; subject experimental construct: 2001 endogenous MG1655 NadK, purified 3400-fold, approximately180-kDa hexamer/30-kDa chain; N terminus MDNHFKCIGI differs at residue2 from current MNNHFKCIGI. a.aria-label: EcoCyc:CPLX0-682 — catalyzes → RHEA:18630; subject experimental construct: 2001 pSK67 yfjB from MG1655 cloned into pET14b with NcoI/BamHI and expressed in BL21(DE3)pLysS; empty SK45 control. a.aria-label: Aerobic respiration control protein ArcA; UniProtKB:P0A9Q1; Declared type: protein; molecular state: Phosphorylated ArcA (native PHOSPHO-ARCA), mapped to reference P0A9Q1. The2014 binding preparation is ArcA-8myc in MG1655; expression comparisons use ΔarcA in anaerobic M9 glucose/ammonium±20mmol KNO3 at37°C. No active deletion protein is asserted.; Evidence EcoCyc:PHOSPHO-ARCA: The exact source state points to unmodified ARCA-MONOMER; state identity remains explicit rather than being treated as unmodified reference protein. (XPath /ptools-xml/Protein/unmodified-form); Evidence PMID:24699140: Methods specify ArcA-8myc, MG1655 derivatives, ΔarcA and anaerobic media with/without nitrate. (XPath /article/body/sec[4]/sec[1]/p); Evidence UniProtKB:P0A9Q1: The issuing ArcA reference has phosphoaspartate54; the active modified state is distinguished from the unmodified reference sequence.
